scenes.setting: a phone and a server on a dark floor
scenes.visual: requests fly from phone to server; a red 429 slams in; a guard appears in front of a door
shots: wide: packets stream phone→server
push in on server as 429 appears
pull back: guard steps in front of the door

scenes.setting: coffee shop counter with barista, ticket jar, cup
scenes.visual: barista waves; close-up on the jar of tickets; a customer walks up and takes a ticket
shots: wide shop
close-up on the jar
wide: customer walks in, ticket flies to them

scenes.setting: barista beside a big jar, a fast clock
scenes.visual: tickets arc into the jar one per second; jar fills to 6 (Full); an extra ticket bounces off and falls away
shots: wide: barista drops tickets as the clock spins
close-up on the jar as it fills and overflows

scenes.setting: a queue of eight people receding toward the counter
scenes.visual: crowd rushes in; six tickets fly out and six people cheer; the last two slump; a new ticket drops into the empty jar
shots: wide: queue rushes in, tickets fly
close on the sad pair at the back
close on the jar: Empty → 1 ticket

scenes.setting: the jar carried into the dark tech world
scenes.visual: jar morphs into a bucket; tokens drop in; client and API nodes connect through it
shots: jar morphs into bucket, title appears
tokens fall in, labelled
wide: client → bucket → API with packets

scenes.visual: a request spends a token and passes; the next finds the bucket empty; a red 429 flies back; Retry-After appears
shots: close: token spent, then empty bucket shakes
wide: 429 returns to the client

scenes.setting: a laptop, a big counter, real response headers
scenes.visual: counter counts up to 5,000 per hour; real x-ratelimit headers highlight line by line
shots: wide: laptop, headers, counter counting
on the headers: remaining line lights up

scenes.setting: two knobs: a bucket and a clock
scenes.visual: bucket fills in a burst (size = burst); clock spins (refill = average); a noisy client floods, only two get through, API stays green
shots: the two knobs appear
noisy client blocked, API protected

scenes.setting: small bucket above a three-line checklist
scenes.visual: three rules check in one by one
shots: checklist reveals line by line
